description: Converts <dataType> value to integer. A double is truncated toward zero (1.9 is 1 and -1.9 is -1); use round(), floor(), or ceil() first for another choice. A double that is NaN, infinite, or outside the integer range is an error. A string is read as XML Schema integer text: digits with an optional sign, leading zeros allowed ("007" is 7). Text that is not an integer ("1.5", " 1", "1x") is an error.
